objective: Preallocate CREATE INDEX and DROP INDEX schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate INDEX schema keys
tasks.result: CREATE INDEX and DROP INDEX schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in CREATE INDEX schema loading and DROP INDEX single-column schema update key construction.
Generated schema key bytes, index creation, index backfill, DROP INDEX schema updates, and index-cache behavior are unchanged.
cargo fmt was run after cargo fmt --check requested import wrapping in the test module.
git diff --check printed the existing CRLF normalization warning for src/execution/ddl/index.rs while exiting successfully.
